MultiHint-9K: Orchestrating Human and AI.summary: The paper builds a pipeline in which human annotators set quality rubrics and AI agents generate, critique and refine Socratic hints, producing MultiHint-9K: 9,987 verified question-answer-hint tuples in English, Italian and Farsi. PharMistral: Drug generation for novel p.summary: The paper presents PharMistral, a Mistral-7B model first trained on over 300,000 human protein sequences and over 1 million drug-like SMILES, then fine-tuned on about 300,000 protein-ligand pairs from ChEMBL to generate candidate drug molecules directly from a protein sequence. Automating Turkish Educational Quiz Gene.summary: The paper introduces Turkish-Quiz-Instruct, a dataset of Turkish educational texts paired with multiple-choice and short-answer questions, and uses GPT-4-Turbo, GPT-3.5-Turbo and Llama-2 models to generate quizzes from Turkish content. A Turkish Educational Crossword Puzzle G.summary: The paper presents the first Turkish crossword puzzle generator based on LLMs, with two new datasets: over 180,000 answer-clue pairs and over 35,000 samples that link text, answer, category and clue. The tool is aimed at classroom use to support vocabulary, memory and problem solving.

Harnessing LLMs for Educational Content-.venue: Proceedings of the Tenth Italian Conference on Computational Linguistics (CLiC-it 2024), Pisa, Italy, CEUR Workshop Proceedings
Harnessing LLMs for Educational Content-.summary: The paper builds a tool that generates Italian crossword puzzles from educational text using GPT-4o, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and Llama3-8B-Instruct, supported by Italian-Clue-Instruct, a dataset of over 30,000 entries. It covers four clue styles: unconstrained clues, definite determiner phrases, copular sentences and bare noun phrases.

Italian Crossword Generator: Enhancing E.venue: Proceedings of the Ninth Italian Conference on Computational Linguistics (CLiC-it 2023), Venice, Italy, CEUR Workshop Proceedings Vol-3596
Italian Crossword Generator: Enhancing E.summary: The paper builds a system that generates and checks Italian crossword clues, fine-tuning GPT-3 models and BERT on a large set of clue-answer pairs and using zero/few-shot prompting to draw clues from texts. Classifiers trained on human-labeled data filter out weak clues, and the evaluation showed the approach produces good educational crosswords.

Building Bridges of Knowledge: Innovatin.venue: 2023 International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2023), Jacksonville, FL, USA, pages 1228-1236, IEEE
Building Bridges of Knowledge: Innovatin.summary: The paper combines GPT-3, GPT2-XL and BERT into a system that generates and verifies crossword clues for educational use, trained on over seven million clue-answer pairs from 1913 to mid-2021. Fine-tuned classifiers and zero-shot checks remove weak clue-answer pairs, and the evaluation results were positive.
